title: rangetest: interval_ms lacks floor; 1ms continuous test is a latent radio flood
description: coap_rangetest.c:545-551 accepts any uint > 0 for interval_ms, stored at :789-793; header documents it as the continuous-test period driving Observe notifications - once a scheduler consumes it, 1ms notifications to all observers floods the radio. Spec example is 5000. Fix: enforce floor (>=1000ms suggested) and/or require OSCORE/local-admin to change it.
close_reason: interval_ms now enforces an inclusive 1000 ms floor (RANGETEST_INTERVAL_MIN_MS): 999 rejected -EBADMSG, 1000 accepted (the valid vector uses exactly 1000; boundary vector rejects 0, unchanged). Auth note: the handler already routes through coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request; the middleware-wide fail-open under LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE=n is a middleware convention, not this module's call. Regression tests test_interval_floor_1000ms (999 reject, 1000 accept, atomicity). Twister 8/8. Commit 4c33ee2345.
